prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [val2][反例] 行标题长于数据 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "考核指标" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 246px
  col 2: header "权重" · longest unbreakable word 33px · one-line width 33px
  col 3: header "目标值" · longest unbreakable word 33px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "实际值" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 48px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示各项考核指标的权重，并比较目标值与实际值。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再查看权重并横向比较目标值与实际值；各行应保持清晰的对应关系。","groups":["目标值和实际值是一组成对比较的数据列，应保持相近的视觉分量。","权重也是数值列，但作用是说明指标占比，而非与目标值比较。"],"keep_intact":["百分比、带比较符号的数值以及带“亿”的金额应尽量保持完整。","列标题应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["较长的考核指标名称可在自然语义边界处换行，包括括号内的说明。","较长指标形成的行高可容纳同一行其他单元格的内容。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [174, 54, 65, 66] · table 360×252px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 2/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [176, 54, 64, 65] · table 360×252px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 2/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 1
Design r1C: widths [172, 54, 66, 67] · table 360×275px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"指标列较宽，第三项指标保持一行；权重和大多数数值完整，目标值与实际值两列的分量也相近。","problems":"目标值和实际值的表头都断成两行，首行的“2.61 亿”也被拆开，削弱了表头识别和横向比较。","cause":"目标值列为65px、实际值列为66px，扣除各21px内边距与边框后，均不足以容纳对应表头；实际值列也不足以容纳完整金额。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"指标列略宽，第三项指标保持一行，目标值与实际值列的宽度相近。","problems":"两个比较列表头仍然断行；首行金额和第二行的“94.5%”也被拆开，数值阅读尤其不顺畅。","cause":"实际值列只有65px，比r1A更窄，扣除21px后可用文本宽度不足；目标值列64px也不足以容纳完整表头。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"实际值表头和“94.5%”保持完整，两列比较数据的视觉分量相近。","problems":"目标值表头和首行金额仍断行；第三项指标末尾只有一个“例”落在第二行，形成突兀的短行并增加行高。","cause":"目标值列66px仍略窄；实际值列67px不足以容纳完整金额。指标列缩至172px后，第三项指标刚好无法放在一行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"完整比较列","widths":[169,54,67,69],"change":"将目标值和实际值扩至可容纳完整表头及数值的宽度，权重列保持不变；指标列收至169px，接受较长指标换行，以优先保证成对比较的数据完整。"},{"name":"兼顾指标宽度","widths":[170,54,67,68],"change":"在完整容纳目标值表头的基础上，给指标列多留1px，检验实际值列68px是否能以更紧凑的宽度保持金额完整，以及指标换行是否更自然。"}]}
